description: §39.2 positive control for E-SCHEMA-015 — a commented-out copy of `assets` that AGREES with the live declaration on `tenant_id` (both carry it). Agreeing declarations are quiet; the whole E-SCHEMA-* family stays silent.
rationale: §39.2: E-SCHEMA-015 fires only when same-name declarations DISAGREE on `tenant_id`; declarations that agree — a commented-out copy included — are not an error. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "stamp all" (i).
